subject: Interchange plan: dataset/promptpack exchange + operational constraints
messages:
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@arcadia.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novusanalytics.com>
Subject: Eval materials exchange + MAP — initial ask

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for taking this — Arcadia is ready to move forward with a mutual action plan to exchange evaluation datasets, prompt packs and a small set of labeled test cases so we can run a 2-week sandbox against Redwood Dedicated. High level asks: 

- We need a transfer mechanism that meets our infosec (SFTP with per-file AES-256 or secure Share).
- Clear usage constraints: ephemeral sandbox only, no downstream redistribution, no model training, strictly for versioned evals.
- A short MAP that lists deliverables, acceptance criteria, and a 30-day post-sandbox retention/escrow plan.

Attached is a spreadsheet with our sample set and basic metadata (arcadia-eval-specs.xlsx). Can you share Redwood's template and a proposed timeline? Our ideal kickoff is next Monday (2027-04-18) with a 2-week sandbox.

Also looping in Priya from Data Ops who will handle the transfer logistics on our side.

Cheers,
Evan Cole
Director of ML
Arcadia AI

[attachment: arcadia-eval-specs.xlsx (xlsx)]

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -0700
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@arcadia.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Eval materials exchange + MAP — initial ask

Evan — thanks, this is straightforward and appreciated. Quick read-through of the spreadsheet looks sane. I attached our working MPA template and a proposed operational checklist so we can get alignment this week. Key notes up front: 

- Transfer options: we support secure S3 presigned URLs (short TTL), SFTP, and our Vaulted Share link. For this flow I recommend S3 presigned or Vaulted Share (recommended for retention controls).
- Sandbox scope: 14 days for evaluation, option to extend one time by 7 days with written approval.
- Usage constraints we require in the MPA: (1) no training/fine-tuning on Redwood Dedicated, (2) no re-distribution outside signatories, (3) dataset must be destroyed or returned 30 days after sandbox unless otherwise negotiated.
- Prompt packs: treated as \"customer-provided prompts\" and covered by the same usage constraints; we ask for a short manifest describing any synthetic augmentation.

Attached: redwood-mpa-template.docx and a brief operational checklist. Next steps I propose: 
1) You confirm transfer mechanism and we exchange SFTP keys / Vaulted Share invite.
2) Monica and Dev will run a short intake (security checklist + promptpack scan) — aim 48-72 hours.
3) We finalize MPA (we can DocuSign) and schedule the sandbox window.

If you confirm kickoff on 2027-04-18 we can start key exchange this week. 

Thanks — copying Monica for the intake and Dev for security sign-off.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

[attachment: redwood-mpa-template.docx (docx)]

Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 11:47:00 -0700
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@arcadia.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Eval materials exchange + MAP — intake details + promptpack guidance

Evan — quick tech notes from the intake perspective so you have a clear checklist: 

1) File layout: one top-level archive per asset-type (datasets/, promptpacks/, testcases/). Please include a small README (UTF-8 text) with field descriptions and provenance.
2) Test cases: label format should be JSONL with fields: id, input, expected_label, tolerance_notes. Please avoid personally identifiable information or mark fields to be redacted.
3) Prompt packs: we ask for a manifest (promptpack-manifest.json) describing prompts, expected system behavior, and example accepted outputs. If prompts include third-party copyrighted content, call it out; we will not redistribute.
4) Redaction & minimization: we will perform an automatic PII scan. Anything flagged as high-risk must be redacted before transfer or it will be quarantined and removed.
5) KV/cache policy: during sandbox we use ephemeral caches; no key material persists after the sandbox window. See attached policy note.

Usage constraints to include in the MPA (technical language we will use): 
- Evaluation-only license: assets used solely for evaluation within the agreed window.
- No model training/fine-tuning defined as: no gradient-based training or weight updates using provided assets; no storing embeddings beyond ephemeral evaluation caches.
- Access control: access limited to named contacts on the MPA; any additional user must be approved in writing.

If that sounds good we will stand up a Vaulted Share and send a one-time upload link. Attachments: promptpack-guidelines.md and kv-cache-policy.txt.

Monica Patel
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

[attachment: promptpack-guidelines.md (md)]
[attachment: kv-cache-policy.txt (txt)]

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 07:04:00 -0700
From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@arcadia.ai>

Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@novusanalytics.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Subject: Re: Eval materials exchange + MAP — intake details + promptpack guidance

Thanks Hannah and Monica — that all looks good. We accept the constraints and the 14-day sandbox with a potential 7-day extension. Priya will prepare a cleaned export and a manifest; we'll use the Vaulted Share option.

Confirmed kickoff: 2027-04-18 09:00 PT, sandbox window 2027-04-18 through 2027-05-01 (inclusive). Priya will send the Vaulted Share invite and upload by EOD 2027-04-14.

One operational ask: can Redwood provide a short-run acceptance test (a 50-case quickcheck) so we can confirm data integrity immediately after upload? If you can share that check by Wednesday we will run it on upload.

Evan
